_doc: LumaUI v71 navigation and structure (K-NAV): tiers, the title island (lNavTtl, .fisl/.nisl/.misl/.crisl), the phone drawer, the tab bar and the phone page header. Deep-merged into design-tokens.json's lumaui object. Every number is read off luma-next-71.html and desktop/phone.css; px unless the key says otherwise.

tiers._doc: v71 2026-09-29 mobile layer: phone under 560 (layout.phone_max_width 559), compact 560 to 900, regular over 900.

title_island._doc: v71 5323-5433 and .fisl/.nisl/.misl: 48 tall, 16 round, the bar's material; a 48 lead with a 20 glyph, a full-height hairline, the title 15/650 over a 12/500 subtitle (line-height 1.2), padding 0 18 0 14; trailing buttons 44 x 48. At left 12, top 52 (6 under the 46 title row). Grown: menu min(320, w - 24) and 128 above the foot; details w - 24 on a phone, min(360, w - 24) in a window; the open shadow 0 32 80 -10 and 0 12 28, the page dimmed .24; once scrolled the header casts 0 8 16 -6. In light the island reads as the frame does (v71 .tbar: frame inks, the title 600).

The floating Back (.phback) is 44 square, 16 round, in the bar material, at the 16 gutter, 6 under the title row (top 50).

Compact (v71 Clock .cktabbar, inside an action bar): icon-only 48 x 48 tabs, the chosen one the raised chip with its glyph lit, a count badge 3 in from the top right, a 7 px green dot 7 in while something runs. A floating bar sits 34 up.
